events.verdict: Kessler (UTA) establishes himself in McDaniels' (MIN) path, firms up and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs as he sets the screen off-ball.
McDaniels (MIN) jumps to contests and initiates contact to Collier's (UTA) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Collier (UTA) legally contests DiVincenzo's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
McDaniels (MIN) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Kessler (UTA) establishes himself in a wide stance in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path, and he delivers illegal contact to Alexander-Walker that affects ability to defend.
McDaniels (MIN) jumps alongside Kessler (UTA) with his arm in a vertical position and marginal body contact occurs during Kessler's upward shooting motion.
Reid (MIN) is last to make contact with the ball before it goes out of bounds, as he reaches in and makes hand-on-ball contact dislodging the balll away from Kessler (UTA).
Sensabaugh (UTA) uses his off-arm to clear space from DiVincenzo (MIN), which affects DiVincenzo's ability to defend during the drive.
Collins (UTA) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) extends his arm to contest and marginal contact occurs to Kessler's (UTA) arm that does not affect his play at the basket.
Collins (UTA) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during DiVincenzo's (MIN) driving shot attempt.
